start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '邕宁区,南宁市' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%82%95%E5%AE%81%E5%8C%BA%2C%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%81%E5%B8%82) -- the source article states only that 'the entire pipeline lies within Yongning District' (该管道全线位于邕宁区境内) without a finer address for the Sinopec station itself, so this is a district-level anchor (Yongning District place node), not station-precise.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '蒲庙镇,邕宁区' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E8%92%B2%E5%BA%99%E9%95%87%2C%E9%82%95%E5%AE%81%E5%8C%BA) -- returned Pumiao Town government office (蒲庙镇人民政府) as a town-level anchor; the source pins the station more precisely as west of 蕾赖村 (Leilai village) and east of 疏港大道 (Harbor Road), but neither the village nor the road segment is separately resolvable in Nominatim.

corridor_notes: Guangxi Daily / Guangxi News Net article (v.gxnews.com.cn, 2020-04-30) on the groundbreaking of '南宁市天然气专供管道工程（中石化南宁站-南宁中燃门站段）' states verbatim: '工程起自中石化南宁站' (the project begins at Sinopec Nanning Station) and '止于邕宁区蒲庙镇蕾赖村西侧、疏港大道东侧的新建蒲庙分输站' (terminates at the newly-built Pumiao distribution station, west of Leilai village and east of Harbor Road, Pumiao Town, Yongning District), adding '该管道全线位于邕宁区境内' (the entire pipeline lies within Yongning District). Total length ~8.9km (exact match to GEM's LengthKnown), groundbreaking 2020-04-28, planned 8-month construction, total investment 67.55 million RMB.
researcher_notes: Building on the pilot pass, which already confirmed existence/classification/specs via this same source: this pass extracted the precise start/end station names and corridor description needed for route drawing. Both endpoints resolve only to district/town level in open geocoding (the underlying source names the stations but not a street address); the finer village/road detail (蕾赖村, 疏港大道) narrows the likely true site of the end station but could not be independently pinned with Nominatim.
